products.name: Piezo Bridge Pickup for Cigar Box Guitar
products.shortDescription: Hand-made hardwood bridge base with a built-in piezo disc and pre-wired lead.
products.description: A hand-made hardwood bridge base with a piezo disc set into the underside and a twisted red/black lead ready to solder to an output jack. Your saddle sits in the routed slot on top, so the strings drive the piezo directly. Shown on a 3-string build.
